// diagnostic

E0777

A function uses an expert effect, such as `Meta.Code.Rewrite`, that its package doesn't hold

What

A function uses an expert effect, such as `Meta.Code.Rewrite`, that its package doesn't hold

Why

No package holds an expert effect by default, and holding a parent such as `Meta` never covers one: only the main package holds one, by naming it or an expert effect above it in `authority.allow`, and a dependency holds one only through the main package's `authority.grants` line for it; a `deny` row always wins

Fix

Add the effect to the main package's `authority: { allow: [...] }` row, or for a dependency to the main package's `authority: { grants: { "name": [...] } }` line, or stop using it

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0777: Tests/UI/meta_expert_leaf_root_only_meta_leaves_code_out.stderr.

Error [jet.ExpertEffectNotHeld]: `build` uses the expert effect `Meta.Code.Rewrite`, which the main package doesn't hold
  --> Tests/UI/meta_expert_leaf_root_only_meta_leaves_code_out.jet:11:10
    |
 11 |     meta.rewrite_body(
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `allow: [Meta]` holds only the effects under `Meta` that are not expert; it leaves out the expert effects `Meta.Code`, `Meta.Host`, which must be named
 Fix: Add `Meta.Code.Rewrite` to the main package's `authority: { allow: [...] }` row, or stop using it in `build`
 Denial: expert
 Call chain: build
